manifest_sha256_method: Non-circular manifest digest: SHA-256 of this manifest serialized as canonical JSON (json.dumps with sort_keys=True, separators=(',' ,':'), ensure_ascii=False) with the manifest_sha256 key omitted. Omitting manifest_sha256 avoids self-reference: the digest is a pure function of the file's content fields only, not of any digest recorded inside the file. This is intentionally not a raw whole-file SHA-256, because a file cannot truthfully record its own full-file hash without a fixed point. The identical digest is recorded in the assembly receipt.
